addhandler-php-on.htaccess.reason: turns PHP on (even for .jpg): never translated

addtype-text-plain.htaccess.reason: only an AddType equal to OLS's default type is a no-op

drupal-sethandler-mixed-case.htaccess.reason: only Drupal's exact spelling is recognised; any other stays a blocker

drupal-sethandler.htaccess.reason: Drupal's no-scripts idiom (SA-2006-006, SA-2013-003): the directory maps every script suffix to a static type (RV-46); the mod_php section is dropped like Apache drops it

files-tilde-regex.htaccess.reason: the regex form of <Files> is not certified

filesmatch-authz-sections.htaccess.reason: both Apache generations, as plugins write it

filesmatch-deny-from-all.htaccess.reason: Apache 2.2 syntax of the same denial

filesmatch-inner-anchor.htaccess.reason: a "^" inside a group: the basename search keeps Apache's meaning (CMP-09: before, the branch could never match and the scripts ran under OLS)

filesmatch-require-denied.htaccess.reason: a deny regex context, plus the same name followed by path info (CMP-09)

filesmatch-top-level-branch.htaccess.reason: a top-level "|": the basename search keeps the alternatives inside this directory (CMP-09: before, the second branch escaped the directory prefix and never matched)

filesmatch-uppercase-alternatives.htacce.reason: case spelled out in the regex

options-execcgi-addhandler.htaccess.reason: AddHandler is never translated; "Options -ExecCGI" alone is a no-op outside cgi-bin

options-execcgi.htaccess.reason: OLS runs CGI only in its cgi-bin context: already off; PHP is not CGI and runs under both

php-admin-flag-engine-off-mod-php-loaded.reason: mod_php7 loaded: Apache turns PHP off; no OLS equivalent

php-admin-flag-engine-off-mod-php.htacce.reason: mod_php is not loaded: Apache ignores the section

php-flag-engine-off-litespeed-mixed-case.reason: as above, any spelling of the setting

php-flag-engine-off-litespeed.htaccess.reason: LiteSpeed's own switch: lsphp has no "engine" setting, OLS would keep running PHP (CMP-09: refused, was a phpIniOverride)

php-flag-engine-off-mod-php-loaded.htacc.reason: mod_php7 loaded: Apache turns PHP off; no OLS equivalent

php-flag-engine-off-mod-php.htaccess.reason: mod_php is not loaded: Apache ignores the sections and runs PHP (PHP-FPM); OLS does the same (nothing to apply)

php-flag-engine-off.htaccess.reason: Apache with PHP-FPM refuses the directive (500); not reproducible

removehandler-litespeed.htaccess.reason: only rewrite, cache and plain php_value lines are taken from a LiteSpeed section

removehandler-mixed-case.htaccess.reason: directive names are case-insensitive in Apache; any spelling stays a blocker

removehandler-mod-mime.htaccess.reason: mod_mime is loaded: Apache applies the section; without a module list the section itself is refused

removehandler.htaccess.reason: removes the PHP handler; no OLS equivalent

sethandler-none-filesmatch.htaccess.reason: Apache serves the scripts as files (source); no OLS equivalent is certified

sethandler-none.htaccess.reason: on cPanel the vhost's <FilesMatch> SetHandler for PHP-FPM is merged after the directory, so Apache may still run PHP: not reproducible

sethandler-php-on.htaccess.reason: turns PHP on for images: never translated
